registry.description: Registry authority the tag was read from.

tag.description: The mutable tag that was resolved.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the manifest bytes received, computed here and never taken from a header.

platforms.description: Platforms declared by direct index descriptors only; nested indexes are not traversed. Not an exhaustive enumeration of runnable platforms; empty for a single manifest.

platform.description: OS/ARCH declared by this direct descriptor.

variant.description: Architecture variant when the descriptor names one.

supported.description: Whether this materializer accepts that platform.
